text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen arrives. Biwa
Hayahide and
I hold a final meeting in
the waiting room before
the race
commences.

She's shocked by the thoroughness of all
the data
I've prepared, and thanks to my
prep work, she's
fully ready to race.

A pre-race poll places her as the top fan
favorite.
In the paddock, she vows to put
on a
performance worthy of such
acclaim.
